purpose: break the neutral safe-circle deadlock V3 converged to by tightening the capture/lock gates so the guidance stops mirroring the opponent's bank before it is actually aimed
based_on: model_variants/V3_DIRECT_CHASE (post velocity_frame=body fix, reproduced 100:100 / 99.68:100 across 4 trials, opponent never took damage)
rationale: At capture_heading_error_deg=180, capture mode activated regardless of aim, and capture_target_bank_blend=1.0 immediately made the guidance copy the opponent's own bank angle instead of computing a real pursuit solution -- producing an endless neutral mirrored circle with the opponent (matches ~750-1200m separation observed across all V3 trials). Narrowing the gate to 40 deg means capture mode only engages once we are already roughly nose-on, so outside that cone the aircraft runs the real intercept-pursuit guidance instead of mirroring. Tightening wez_hold_latch_ata_deg 15->4 makes the hold-lock commit only once genuinely aligned, rather than latching (and then coasting) from a loose angle.

results.notes: First trial all night where the opponent took ANY damage (previously 0/14+ trials across original checkpoint + V1/V2/V3). Round appears to have been cut short mid-fight (both AI clients disconnected around t~30s of 200s) while damage was still being actively exchanged, so this is not a completed round -- reproducibility not yet confirmed.
